Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data extraction error in Step 7. While correctly identifying Michael Doeberl's birth and death dates (1861–1928), the Planner incorrectly attributed Edward Dearle's death year as 1861 instead of the correct 1891 found in the search results. This led to a miscalculation of Edward Dearle's lifespan (55 years instead of 85 years) and an incorrect final conclusion that Michael Doeberl lived longer, when in reality Edward Dearle lived longer.
